qe: Bihar is at present divided into how many divisions and districts?
qh: बिहार वर्तमान में कितने प्रमंडलों तथा जिलों में विभाजित है?
e: Bihar me prashasanik suvidha ke liye rajya ko pramandalon (divisions) tatha jilon (districts) me baanta gaya hai. Vartaman me Bihar me 9 pramandal hain - Patna, Magadh, Saran, Tirhut, Darbhanga, Kosi, Purnea, Bhagalpur tatha Munger - tatha 38 jile hain. Har pramandal ka mukhiya ek 'Pramandal Adhikari' (Commissioner) hota hai, jo apne kshetra ke jilon ke kaam par nazar rakhta hai; har jile ka mukhiya 'Zila Adhikari' (District Magistrate/Collector) hota hai tatha 'Zila Parishad' zila-star par lok-tantra ka adhaar hota hai. Jila aage anumandalon (subdivisions), prakhandon (blocks) tatha panchayats me banta hai. Rajya ka bhautik kshetra 94,163 square kilometre hai, jisme uttar Bihar me ghanatv zyada tatha dakshin-pashchim ke pahadi jilon me kam hota hai. Samastipur aur Bhagalpur jaise jilon ko milakar banaye gaye vikalp galat hain, isliye sahi uttar '9 pramandal tatha 38 jile' hai. Exam point: Bihar me 9 pramandal tatha 38 jile hain; pramandal ka mukhiya Commissioner tatha jila ka mukhiya District Magistrate hota hai; 2000 me Jharkhand alag hone ke baad jo hissa bacha wahi aaj ka Bihar hai.

qe: How many seats does Bihar have in the Lok Sabha and the Rajya Sabha respectively?
qh: बिहार के पास क्रमशः लोकसभा तथा राज्यसभा में कितनी सीटें हैं?
e: Bihar se Lok Sabha me 40 sadasya chune jaate hain; Lok Sabha ke sadasya praja dwara seedhe chunav (direct election) se chune jaate hain. Rajya Sabha me Bihar ka pratinidhitva 16 sadasyaon ka hai; Rajya Sabha ke sadasya vidhan sabha ke chune hue sadasyaon dwara ekal sthantaran (single transferable vote) ki vyavastha se chune jaate hain, isliye unhe 'upper house' ka ghar bhi kaha jaata hai. Rajya me Vidhan Sabha (lower house) ki 243 tatha Vidhan Parishad (upper house) ki 75 sadasyaon ki vyavastha hai - Bihar un thode rajyon me hai jahan do sadan wali vidhayika (bicameral legislature) hai. Lok Sabha ki sambhavit seat sankhya praja-sankhya ke aadhaar par tay hoti hai; Bihar ki jansankhya 10.41 crore (Census 2011) hone ke bawajood 2026 tak seat sankhya 40 hi hai, kyunki parsiman (delimitation) ki prakriya ruki hui hai. Isliye '40 tatha 16' hi sahi jodi hai. Exam point: Bihar - Lok Sabha 40 seat, Rajya Sabha 16 seat, Vidhan Sabha 243 seat tatha Vidhan Parishad 75 seat; Bihar me dvigri (bicameral) vidhayika hai.

qe: Who was the first Chief Minister of Bihar, who took office in 1937 as Premier and became Chief Minister in 1946?
qh: बिहार के प्रथम मुख्यमंत्री कौन थे, जो 1937 में प्रीमियर बने तथा 1946 में मुख्यमंत्री बने?
e: Dr. Sri Krishna Singh, jinhe 'Bihar Kesari' aur pyar se 'Sri Babu' kaha jaata hai, Bihar ke pehle Premier (1937) tatha azaadi ke baad pehle Mukhyamantri (1946 se 1961) the. Unka janm Sheikhpura jile ke Maur gaon me hua tha; 1930 ke Namak Satyagraha ke dauran unhone Begusarai ke Garhpura me kanoon todkar andolan chalaun tatha jail bhi gaye. Mukhyamantri ke roop me unhone apne up-Mukhyamantri Dr. Anugrah Narayan Sinha ke saath milkar Bihar me 1950 ka 'Bihar Bhumi Sudhar Kanoon' (Bihar Land Reforms Act) pass karwaya, jisse zamindari vyavastha khatm hui; is tarah Bihar zamindari khatm karne wala bharat ka pehla rajya bana. Unki smriti me Patna me Sri Krishna Memorial Hall tatha Sri Krishna Vigyan Kendra bane tatha 21 October ko unki jayanti manayi jaati hai. Anugrah Narayan Sinha pehle up-Mukhyamantri the, Mahamaya Prasad Sinha 1967 me pehle gair-Congress CM bane tatha Karpoori Thakur 1970-71 me CM bane. Exam point: Bihar ke pehle Mukhyamantri = Dr. Sri Krishna Singh ('Bihar Kesari'); Bihar Land Reforms Act 1950 se zamindari khatm - Bihar pehla rajya; pehle up-Mukhyamantri = Anugrah Narayan Sinha ('Bihar Vibhuti').

qe: Who was the first Deputy Chief Minister and Finance Minister of Bihar, known as 'Bihar Vibhuti'?
qh: बिहार के प्रथम उप-मुख्यमंत्री तथा वित्त मंत्री कौन थे, जिन्हें 'बिहार विभूति' कहा जाता है?
e: Dr. Anugrah Narayan Sinha (janm Poiyawan, Aurangabad) ko 'Bihar Vibhuti' kaha jaata hai; woh 1946 se 1957 tak Bihar ke pehle up-Mukhyamantri tatha pehle Vitt Mantri (Finance Minister) rahe. Unhone Champaran Satyagraha (1917) me Gandhi ji ke saath milkar kisanon ke bayaan darj kiye tatha 1930 ke namak satyagrah tatha 1942 ke Bharat Chhodo Andolan me bhi bhaag liya. Mukhyamantri Sri Krishna Singh ke saath unhone Bihar ki aarthik neeti ka blueprint banaya - Kosi tatha Gandak pariyojnaon ka samarthan, krishi tatha sinchai par zor, tatha rajya ke udyogon ko protsahit karna. Unki smriti me Patna me A.N. Sinha Institute of Social Studies tatha A.N. College banaye gaye. Dr. Sachchidananda Sinha samvidhan sabha ke asthayi adhyaksh the, Jagjivan Ram kendriya mantri tatha up-Pradhanmantri rahe, tatha Basawon Singh krantikari tatha Congress Socialist Party ke sahyogi the. Exam point: Bihar ke pehle up-Mukhyamantri tatha pehle Vitt Mantri = Dr. Anugrah Narayan Sinha ('Bihar Vibhuti', 1946-1957); ANSISS Patna unke naam par.

qe: Who was the first non-Congress Chief Minister of Bihar, who headed the Samyukta Vidhayak Dal government in 1967?
qh: बिहार के प्रथम गैर-कांग्रेसी मुख्यमंत्री कौन थे, जिन्होंने 1967 में संयुक्त विधायक दल की सरकार बनाई?
e: 1967 ke aam chunav ke baad Bihar me Congress ka ekal shasan khatm ho gaya tatha 'Samyukta Vidhayak Dal' (SVD) naam se gathbandhan ki sarkar bani; iske Mukhyamantri Mahamaya Prasad Sinha 5 March 1967 ko bane, isliye woh Bihar ke pehle gair-Congressi Mukhyamantri kehlate hain. Us chunav me unhone Patna West se Congress ke Mukhyamantri K.B. Sahay ko hara kar charchit jite haasil ki thi. SVD sarkar me Karpoori Thakur up-Mukhyamantri bane the tatha doosre dalon ke neta bhi shaamil the; Bharat me gathbandhan ki rajneeti (coalition politics) ke puraane udaharan me Bihar ki SVD sarkar ek mahatvapurn sthal rakhti hai. Is sarkar ne shaikshik tatha samajik sudhar ke kuch kadam uthe, lekin andaruni matbhedon ke kaaran yah lambi nahi chali. Bindeshwari Dubey baad me Congress ke Mukhyamantri bane tatha Satyendra Narayan Sinha bhi Bihar ke Mukhyamantri rahe, isliye woh sahi vikalp nahi hain. Exam point: Bihar ke pehle gair-Congressi Mukhyamantri = Mahamaya Prasad Sinha (SVD sarkar, 5 March 1967), jisme Karpoori Thakur up-Mukhyamantri the.

qe: The Patna High Court, which is the highest court of Bihar, was established in which year?
qh: बिहार का सर्वोच्च न्यायालय पटना उच्च न्यायालय किस वर्ष स्थापित हुआ?
e: Patna High Court ki sthapna 1 March 1916 ko hui; yah Bihar tatha Orissa pradesh ka uchch nyayalaya tha tatha iska pura naya bhavan Patna me Ganga kinare banaa. 1936 me Orissa alag pradesh bana, to Patna High Court sirf Bihar ke liye rah gaya; 15 November 2000 ko Jharkhand alag rajya bana, tab Ranchi me alag uchch nyayalaya banaya gaya. Uchch nyayalaya (High Court) kisi rajya ke andar sabse bada nyayalaya hota hai - yah mool adhikar (fundamental rights) ki raksha karta hai, nichli adalaton ke faislon par appeal sunta hai tatha sarkar ke kanoonon ki vaidhata ki jaanch kar sakta hai; iska mukhiya 'Chief Justice' hota hai. Isliye 1912 (Bihar alag prant banne ka varsh), 1936 (Orissa alag hone ka varsh) tatha 1950 (samvidhan lagu hone ka varsh) me bhi koi bhi sthapna nahi hui, isliye 1916 hi sahi uttar hai. Exam point: Patna High Court = 1916 me sthapit; 1936 me Orissa tatha 2000 me Jharkhand alag hone par kshetra-adhikar badla; aaj Bihar ka kendriya nyayalaya Patna me hai.

qe: Who was the first Governor of Bihar after India became a Republic in 1950?
qh: 1950 में भारत गणराज्य बनने के बाद बिहार के प्रथम राज्यपाल कौन थे?
e: Bharat ke ganrajya banane ke baad (26 January 1950) Bihar ke pehle Rajyapal (Governor) Jairamdas Daulatram bane; unhone 1948 se 1956 tak is pad ko snbhaala. Rajyapal rajya me sanvidhanik mukhiya hote hain - woh Mukhyamantri tatha mantriparishad ki salah par kaam karte hain, vidhan sabha ke paas hue vidhayak-billon ko apni svikriti dete hain tatha rajya ke vishwavidyalaya ke Kulguru (Chancellor) bhi hote hain. Azaadi se pehle Bihar me Governor ka pad 1936 se tha, par 1950 me samvidhan lagu hone ke baad pehle sanvidhanik Rajyapal ke roop me Daulatram ji aaye. Dr. Rajendra Prasad bharat ke pehle Rashtrapati bane, Dr. Sri Krishna Singh Bihar ke Mukhyamantri the tatha Sachchidananda Sinha samvidhan sabha ke asthayi adhyaksh the - isliye woh teeno sahi nahi hain. Exam point: Bihar ke pehle Rajyapal (1950 ke baad) = Jairamdas Daulatram; Rajyapal Mukhyamantri ki salah par kaam karte hain tatha vishwavidyalaya ke Chancellor hote hain.

qe: Bihar and Orissa were formed into a separate province in 1912; in which year did Orissa become a separate province, leaving Bihar as a governor's province?
qh: 1912 में बिहार और उड़ीसा को मिलाकर पृथक प्रांत बनाया गया था; किस वर्ष उड़ीसा अलग प्रांत बना, जिससे बिहार गवर्नर के प्रांत के रूप में रह गया?
e: 22 March 1912 ko Bengal se alag kar 'Bihar and Orissa' naam ka naya prant banaya gaya tha; isi ghatna ki smriti me aaj 22 March ko Bihar Diwas manaya jaata hai. Kuch samay baad Orissa ke logon ki apni alag pehchan ki maang tez hui tatha Government of India Act 1935 ke aadhaar par 1 April 1936 ko Orissa alag prant bana; uske baad Bihar gavarnar ke apne prant ke roop me rah gaya. Isi badlav ka asar Patna High Court par bhi pada, jo 1916 me Bihar-Orissa ke liye bana tha aur 1936 ke baad sirf Bihar ke kshetra-adhikar me aa gaya. Iske baad 15 November 2000 ko ek aur bade vibhajan me Bihar se alag kar Jharkhand rajya banaya gaya, jisse aaj ka Bihar 38 jilon wala rajya ban gaya. Isliye is prashn ka sahi varsh 1936 hai; 1912 prant banne ka, 1950 samvidhan lagu hone ka tatha 1919 Montagu-Chelmsford sudhar ka varsh tha. Exam point: 1912 = Bihar and Orissa prant ka gathan (Bihar Diwas ki tariq), 1 April 1936 = Orissa alag prant (Bihar gavarnar ka prant), 15 November 2000 = Bihar se Jharkhand alag.

qe: Dr. Rajendra Prasad, who was President of the Constituent Assembly and the first President of India, belonged to which district of Bihar?
qh: संविधान सभा के अध्यक्ष तथा भारत के प्रथम राष्ट्रपति डॉ. राजेन्द्र प्रसाद बिहार के किस जिले से थे?
e: Dr. Rajendra Prasad ka janm Siwan jile ke Ziradei gaon me hua tha; unhe 'Deshratna' tatha 'Ajatshatru' kaha jaata hai (Ajatshatru ka arth hai jiska koi shatru na ho). Woh 11 December 1946 ko Samvidhan Sabha ke sthayi adhyaksh chune gaye tatha samvidhan banne ke baad 1950 se 1962 tak bharat ke pehle Rashtrapati rahe; isi karan unhe 1962 me Bharat Ratna mila. 1917 ke Champaran Satyagraha me woh Gandhi ji ke saath kisanon ke bayaan lene tatha unki samasyayein jaanne me shaamil the; 1934 ke Bihar bhukamp ke samay unhone rahat-karya ka netritva kiya. Unki smriti me Patna ke Bans Ghat par Rajendra Samadhi Sthal tatha Rajendra Smriti Sangrahalaya (Sadaqat Ashram) sthit hai. Saran, Gopalganj tatha Bhojpur anya jile hain jahan anya swatantrata-senaniyon ka janm hua, isliye Rajendra Babu ke liye 'Siwan' hi sahi hai. Exam point: Dr. Rajendra Prasad = janm Ziradei, Siwan; 'Deshratna' tatha 'Ajatshatru'; Samvidhan Sabha ke sthayi adhyaksh (11 December 1946) tatha bharat ke pehle Rashtrapati (1950-1962), Bharat Ratna 1962.

qe: On 1 November 1956, Bihar transferred about 3,166 square miles of its area to which neighbouring state?
qh: 1 नवंबर 1956 को बिहार ने अपना लगभग 3,166 वर्ग मील क्षेत्र किस पड़ोसी राज्य को हस्तांतरित किया?
e: 1 November 1956 ko rajya punargathan ke samay Bihar ka ek bada kshetra padosi West Bengal ko diya gaya; kul milakar 3,166 square mile kshetra gaya, jisme Purnea jile ke 759 square mile tatha Manbhum jile ke 2,407 square mile shaamil the. Is kshetra me lagbhag 14,46,385 log rahte the tatha isme Manbhum jile ke Purulia ilaake ke kai thane (Jaipur, Hura, Barabazar, Balarampur aadi) tatha Purnea jile ke Kishanganj upmandal ka ek hissa shaamil tha. Seema tatha zameen ki yah katti-chaanti ek Revenue Officer ki nigrani me hui, jiski niyukti Kendriya Sarkar ne ki tatha nirdharan ka aadhaar Dalkola-Kishanganj-Chopra-Siliguri highway tatha Dalkola-Raiganj marg ke aas-paas ki seema thi. Isliye sahi uttar West Bengal hai. Exam point: 1 November 1956 ko Bihar ne West Bengal ko lagbhag 3,166 square mile kshetra diya - Purnea 759 tatha Manbhum 2,407 square mile; is kshetra me Purulia ilaaka mukhya tha tatha seema nirdharan Kendriya Sarkar dwara niyukt Revenue Officer ne kiya.

qe: Which district's subdivision, Purulia, was transferred from Bihar to West Bengal in 1956?
qh: 1956 में बिहार से पश्चिम बंगाल को हस्तांतरित कौन-सा उपमंडल (पुरुलिया) था?
e: Purulia Manbhum jile ka ek upmandal tha tatha 1956 me yah poora ilaaka Bihar se nikal kar West Bengal me chala gaya; isi ke saath Manbhum ke kai thane bhi gaye, jaise Jaipur, Hura, Barabazar, Balarampur, Puncha, Santuri aadi. Manbhum jila apne aap me ek bahut purana prashasanik kshetra tha, jiska bada hissa aaj bhi West Bengal tatha Jharkhand ke beech banta hua dikhta hai; iska naam 'Manbhum' bhumij-kshetra se juda hua maana jaata hai, jahan bhumij tatha anya aadivasi samuday rahte the. Isi vajah se 1956 ke baad Manbhum jile ka naam-badal hua tatha uska ek hissa Purulia jila ke roop me West Bengal me tatha doosra hissa Dhanbad aadi ke roop me aage chala. Purnea ka ek chhota hissa (759 square mile) bhi West Bengal ko gaya, lekin poora upmandal ke taur par Purulia ka hantaran Manbhum se hi juda hai - isliye sahi uttar Manbhum hai. Exam point: Purulia upmandal = Manbhum jile se, 1956 me West Bengal ko; Purnea ka 759 square mile hissa bhi 1956 me gaya; Manbhum kshetra aadivasi-bahul tha.

qe: The area transferred from Bihar to West Bengal in 1956 had a population of about how many persons?
qh: 1956 में बिहार से पश्चिम बंगाल को गए क्षेत्र की जनसंख्या लगभग कितनी थी?
e: 1956 me Bihar se West Bengal ko gaye kshetra ki jansankhya lagbhag 14,46,385 (yaani takriban 14.5 lakh) thi; is kshetra me Manbhum jile ke Purulia ilaake ke kai thane tatha Purnea jile ke Kishanganj upmandal ka ek hissa shaamil the. Jansankhya ke aise aankdon ka mahatva isliye hota hai kyunki seema badalne se dono rajyon ke ghanatv, jansankhya-anupat tatha vidhan-sabha seaton ke aankdon par bhi asar padta hai; yahi karan hai ki 1956 ke baad Bihar tatha West Bengal dono ki jansankhya-ginti badli. Aaj Bihar ka kshetrafal lagbhag 94,163 square kilometre hai tatha yah 1956 me hui katti ke baad ka aankda hai; isliye 1956 ki seema-katti ko samajhna rajya ke bhoogol ke liye zaroori hai. Chand lakh tatha crore ke antar par dhyan dena zaroori hai, isliye sahi uttar 'lagbhag 14.5 lakh' hai. Exam point: 1956 me Bihar se West Bengal ko gaye kshetra ki jansankhya lagbhag 14.5 lakh (14,46,385); kshetrafal 3,166 square mile; aaj Bihar ka kshetrafal lagbhag 94,163 square kilometre hai.

qe: What was the basis used in 1956 to demarcate the Bihar-West Bengal boundary in the transferred area?
qh: 1956 में हस्तांतरित क्षेत्र में बिहार-पश्चिम बंगाल सीमा का निर्धारण किस आधार पर किया गया?
oe: The course of the Ganga river
Distance from highways such as the Dalkola-Kishanganj-Siliguri road
The line of the railway track
e: 1956 me seema ka nirdharan karne ke liye Kendriya Sarkar ne ek Revenue Officer niyukta kiya; usne seema nirdharan ka aadhaar sadak (highway) rakha - jaise Dalkola, Kishanganj tatha Chopra ko Siliguri se jodne wali highway ke lagbhag 200 gaj pashchim ki line tatha Dalkola-Karandighi-Raiganj marg ke 200 gaj dakshin ya dakshin-pashchim ki line. Isi aadhaar par Purnea jile ke Kishanganj upmandal ka ek hissa tatha Gopalpur thana ka kuch hissa West Bengal ko diya gaya, jabki baaki Bihar ke paas raha. Sadak-par adhaarit seema ka matlab yah tha ki gaon-sadak tatha bazaar ke raste aas-paas ke ilaake ke saath jude rahein tatha logon ka aana-jaana aasan bana rahe. Ganga ki dhara, rail-line ya van-khand is seema nirdharan ke aadhaar nahi the - isliye sahi uttar sadak-highway se doori hai. Exam point: 1956 ki Bihar-West Bengal seema = highway (Dalkola-Kishanganj-Siliguri tatha Dalkola-Raiganj marg) se lagbhag 200 gaj doori ke aadhaar par; nirdharan Kendriya Sarkar dwara niyukt Revenue Officer ne kiya.

qe: Which subdivision of Purnea district lost a portion of its area to West Bengal in the 1956 boundary settlement?
qh: 1956 की सीमा-व्यवस्था में पूर्णिया जिले के किस उपमंडल का एक हिस्सा पश्चिम बंगाल को गया?
e: 1956 ki seema-katti me Purnea jile ke Kishanganj upmandal ka woh hissa West Bengal ko diya gaya jo nirdharit seema-rekha ke purab tatha Gopalpur thana se sambandhit tha; yani pura Kishanganj nahi gaya, balki highway-based line ke purab ka ilaaka gaya. Purnea jile ne kul milakar 759 square mile kshetra khoya, jabki baaki hissa Bihar ke paas raha tatha aage chal kar yah kshetra Araria, Katihar tatha Kishanganj jilon me bant gaya. Aise vibhajan se samajh aata hai ki 1947 ke baad bhi seema badalti rahi tatha rajya punargathan ke samay kshetrafal tatha jansankhya dono ke aankde badle. Araria, Katihar tatha Forbesganj jaise upmandal ya kshetra alag hain tatha unka koi hissa 1956 me West Bengal ko nahi gaya - isliye sahi uttar Kishanganj hai. Exam point: 1956 me Purnea jile ke Kishanganj upmandal tatha Gopalpur thana ka kuch hissa West Bengal ko gaya; Purnea ne kul 759 square mile khoya; aage yahi kshetra Araria, Katihar tatha Kishanganj jilon me banta.

qe: Within what area and with how many ratepayers was the municipal administration of Patna town being carried on in the early 1920s?
qh: बीसवीं सदी के आरंभ में पटना नगर का नगरपालिका प्रशासन कितने क्षेत्र में तथा कितने रेटपेयरों के साथ चल रहा था?
oh: पाँच वर्ग मील में तथा 4,878 रेटपेयरों के साथ
पाँच वर्ग मील में तथा 720 रेटपेयरों के साथ
पचास वर्ग मील में तथा 48,780 रेटपेयरों के साथ
पंद्रह वर्ग मील में तथा 4,878 रेटपेयरों के साथ
e: Nagarpalika yaani municipality ko nagar ki safai, paani, roshni tatha anya nagar-sevaon ka prabhar diya jaata tha. Ratepayer aise vyakti ko kehte the, jo nagarpalika ko rates tatha taxes deta tha tatha is karan nagarpalika ke chunav me vote ka haq rakhta tha. Patna municipal board ka kshetra paanch square mile tha tatha usme 4,878 ratepayers the; board ki aay ke mukhya sadhan rates tatha taxes, cattle-pound yaani pashu-bandh se aane wali raqam, Government se milne wali grants tatha Local Funds se milne wali grants thi. Nagar me sabse bada kharch safai yaani conservancy par hota tha; 1921-22 me Patna nagarpalika ne conservancy par Rs 14,363 tatha aspatalon tatha dawakhanon par Rs 11,181 kharch kiye. Exam point: Patna ka municipal kshetra paanch square mile tha tatha usme 4,878 ratepayers the; ratepayer woh hota tha jo nagarpalika ko rate-tax deta tha tatha chunav me vote ka haq rakhta tha.

qe: The town of Khagaul was constituted a municipality on which date?
qh: खगौल नगर को किस तारीख़ को नगरपालिका बनाया गया?
e: Jile me Patna ke alawa kuch anya nagar bhi nagarpalika ke roop me sanchalit the; Khagaul nagar ko 1 July 1907 ko nagarpalika banaya gaya. Wahan us samay 1,338 ratepayers the tatha municipal board me kul gyarah commissioners the, jinme se nau nirvachit yaani elected the tatha shesh sadasya anya madhyam se aate the. Khagaul ek mahatvapurna nagar tha, kyunki yahan se hokar Patna-Gaya Canal tatha railway line jaati thi tatha aspaas krishi ka vyapar hota tha. Nagarpalika ke saalana aay-kharch me rates tatha taxes, cattle-pounds tatha Government se milne wali grants shamil thi tatha kharch me administration, lighting, conservancy, roads tatha education ke shirsh the. Exam point: Khagaul nagar 1 July 1907 ko nagarpalika bana; wahan 1,338 ratepayers the tatha 11 commissioners ka board tha, jinme 9 nirvachit the.

qe: How many of the eleven commissioners of the Khagaul municipal board were elected?
qh: खगौल नगरपालिका बोर्ड के ग्यारह आयुक्तों में कितने निर्वाचित थे?
e: Khagaul nagarpalika ke board me kul gyarah commissioners the, jinme se nau nirvachit yaani elected the. Nagarpalika ke kaam me administration yaani prabandh, lighting yaani roshni, conservancy yaani safai, roads yaani sadke tatha education yaani shiksha jaise shirsh shamil the. 1921-22 ke aas-paas Khagaul nagarpalika ka kul kharch lagbhag 14,775 rupees tha, jisme safai par sabse adhik Rs 6,208 lagaye gaye; prabandh par Rs 3,092 tatha roshni par Rs 2,599 kharch hue, jabki sadkon par keval Rs 448. Is sankshipt vishleshan se pata chalta hai ki chhote nagar-palikaon me bhi safai tatha roshni jaise mool kaamon par sabse adhik dhan kharch hota tha. Exam point: Khagaul nagarpalika ke 11 commissioners me se 9 nirvachit the; nagarpalika ke kharch me safai (Rs 6,208) tatha prabandh (Rs 3,092) mukhya shirsh the.

qe: The Patna Administration Committee, which administered the area within the new capital in respect of lighting, drainage, conservancy and the municipal market, was nominated under which Act?
qh: नई राजधानी के भीतर के क्षेत्र का, रोशनी, नाली-निकासी, सफ़ाई तथा नगरीय बाज़ार के मामले में प्रशासन करने वाली पटना प्रशासन समिति किस अधिनियम के अंतर्गत नामित की गई?
e: Patna me do alag-alag sansthayein nagar-sevaon ka kaam dekhti thi - purane nagar ke liye municipal board tatha nayi rajdhani ke kshetra ke liye Patna Administration Committee. Yah Committee Act I of 1915 ke antargat nominated yaani namit ki gayi thi tatha usme nau sadasya the. Iske kaam me roshni, drainage yaani nali-nikasi, conservancy yaani safai, municipal market yaani nagariya bazar tatha building regulations yaani bhavan-nirman ke niyamon ka palan karana shamil tha; is kshetra me 720 ratepayers the. Chunki yah kshetra abhi poora ban raha tha, isliye iski aay ka mukhya sadhan Government ki grant thi; 1921-22 me rates tatha taxes se aay Rs 68,231 hui thi tatha Committee ne safai par Rs 31,928 kharch kiye. Exam point: Patna Administration Committee Act I of 1915 ke antargat namit hui thi tatha isme nau sadasya the; yah roshni, drainage, safai, nagariya bazar tatha bhavan-nirman niyamon ka prabandh dekhti thi tatha iske 720 ratepayers the.

qe: What has hitherto been the main source of income of the Patna Administration Committee, dealing as it does with a city still in course of completion?
qh: पटना प्रशासन समिति की आय का मुख्य स्रोत अब तक क्या रहा है, जो एक ऐसे नगर का काम देख रही है जो अभी पूरा बन रहा है?
oh: सरकार से मिलने वाली अनुदान राशि
e: Patna Administration Committee ka kshetra nayi rajdhani ka woh bhaag tha jo abhi poora ban raha tha; isliye wahan aabadi tatha sampatti seemit thi tatha rates-taxes se aay kam hoti thi. Isi karan is Committee ki aay ka mukhya sadhan ab tak Government se milne wali grant rahi. 1921-22 me rates tatha taxes se aay Rs 68,231 hui thi tatha Committee ne administration par Rs 6,772, lighting par Rs 5,810, conservancy par Rs 31,928 tatha anya safai-sambandhi kaamon par Rs 5,400 kharch kiye. Aise aankde batate hain ki naye shahari kshetra me shuru me sadke, naliyan tatha safai jaise mool kaam sarkari dhan se hi pure kiye jaate the. Exam point: nayi rajdhani ke bante kshetra me rates-taxes se aay kam thi, isliye Patna Administration Committee ki aay ka mukhya sadhan Government ki grant rahi; safai par sabse adhik Rs 31,928 kharch hua.

qe: In 1921-22 the Patna municipality spent the largest amount, Rs 14,363, on which single head of expenditure?
qh: 1921-22 में पटना नगरपालिका ने किस एक मद पर सबसे अधिक, 14,363 रुपये व्यय किए?
e: Patna nagarpalika ke kharch ke mukhya shirsh the - administration yaani prabandh, lighting yaani roshni, conservancy yaani safai, hospitals yaani aspatal tatha dawakhaney, roads yaani sadke tatha education yaani shiksha. 1921-22 me sabse bada kharch safai yaani conservancy par Rs 14,363 hua, jabki aspatalon tatha dawakhanon par Rs 11,181 tatha prabandh par Rs 3,290 kharch hue. Iska karan yah tha ki nagar me ghar ek doosre se sate hue the, nali-paani tatha kachra hatane ki vyavastha mushkil thi tatha 1884 ke Municipal Act ke baad safai jaise kaam nagarpalika ki pratham zimmedari ban gaye the; isi karan safai par sabse adhik dhan lagta tha. Exam point: 1921-22 me Patna nagarpalika ka sabse bada kharch safai par Rs 14,363 hua, jabki aspatalon tatha dawakhanon par Rs 11,181 tatha prabandh par Rs 3,290 kharch hue.
